kept.name: openai-codex-claude-code-proxy
kept.reason: Runs Claude Code on non-Anthropic models through a local proxy that translates its API requests, with different models per agent tier; the same setup could point a coding agent at a locally served Qwen or other open-weight model.

kept.name: prompt-assembly-cache-discipline
kept.reason: Rules for keeping prompts cache-friendly, such as never rewriting the start of the prompt and avoiding sliding windows, which matter most when you rely on long context with slow local prompt processing.

kept.name: thunderjar
